topics.lqft: LQFT (Lazy Query Fenwick Tree) is a persistent data structure for range queries and point updates. The LQFT Benchmark page on this portfolio compares performance, memory density, and complexity against other approaches with interactive browser demos.
topics.fenwick tree: A Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree) supports point updates and prefix/range queries in O(log n) time with O(n) space. Parjad's LQFT Benchmark explores variants and practical trade-offs.
topics.persistent data structure: Persistent structures keep prior versions after updates. The LQFT Benchmark project demonstrates persistent-tree ideas with visual complexity and memory comparisons.
topics.react: Parjad builds interactive UIs with React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Several portfolio projects use React on the frontend with Node/Express APIs.
topics.node: The portfolio backend uses Node.js and Express with MongoDB, Redis caching, and JWT admin auth.
topics.mongodb: MongoDB stores projects, blog posts, analytics, and the editable AI knowledge base used by this assistant.
topics.mock interview: The Mock Interview page at /interview lets recruiters ask technical questions to an AI playing Parjad in character. Rate limits apply to keep usage sustainable.
